clue.text: In bar, I'm with a female that's upset close friend

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the string of pieces upside down, so it reads from the bottom up

parts.note: a rail is a bar, as on a fence
taken as written, without the apostrophe
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone at a pub, joined by a woman, is upset and turns to a close friend.
explanation.definitionFit: A familiar is an intimate companion, someone well known to you.

clue.text: Second of three equal parts in premeditated corrective action

indicators.text: Second of three equal parts in
indicators.note: the twelve-letter word premeditated splits into three runs of four letters, and the clue asks for the middle run

parts.note: the four letters in the middle third of this word are the answer

explanation.surface: A legal-sounding phrase about premeditation being split among three parties.
explanation.walkthrough: PREM-EDIT-ATED: the twelve letters fall into three fours, and the second four is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To edit is to correct and revise a text, a corrective action on writing.

clue.text: Private penning article that's comparatively silly

indicators.note: to pen is to enclose, so the first word holds the second inside it

parts.note: inner thoughts are private ones
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A soldier writing an article that turns out rather foolish.
explanation.walkthrough: Private looks like a soldier, but it means inner, as in private feelings.
explanation.definitionFit: Inaner is the comparative of inane, meaning more foolish or empty-headed.

clue.text: Among which ours comes third, but isn't included in seven, musically

definitions.text: Among which ours comes third, but isn't included in seven, musically

parts.words: Among which ours comes third, but isn't included in seven, musically
parts.note: Earth is third from the Sun, but Holst's orchestral suite has seven movements and none for Earth

explanation.surface: A riddle about a list of seven things where ours ranks third but is left out.
explanation.walkthrough: Gustav Holst's suite of this name has movements for Mars to Neptune but omits Earth.
explanation.definitionFit: Earth is the third of the worlds orbiting the Sun, yet Holst's famous work leaves our own world out.

clue.text: Nigerian university admitting French or German woman

indicators.note: letting someone in, so the first pieces take the second inside them

parts.note: the Hausa are a people of northern Nigeria

explanation.surface: A Nigerian university admits a French or German woman as a student.
explanation.walkthrough: 'French or German' reads as a choice of nationality, but French gives only FR and the definition is German woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Hausfrau is the German word for a housewife, borrowed into English for a German homemaker.

clue.text: A couple of flyers that striker uses when dispatching deliveries

definitions.meaning: first meaning: read as two words, a cricket (a flying insect) and a bat (a flying mammal)

definitions.text: that striker uses when dispatching deliveries
definitions.meaning: second meaning: the willow implement a batsman swings at balls bowled to him

explanation.surface: Two winged creatures and the thing a batsman swings at incoming balls.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a delivery is a ball bowled at the batsman, called the striker.
explanation.definitionFit: The willow implement a batsman holds to hit each ball the bowler sends down.

clue.text: Unprincipled about runs in first season

indicators.note: going round, so the first word wraps around the second

parts.note: venal means open to bribery, lacking principle
R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A corrupt operator scoring runs at the start of the cricket season.
explanation.definitionFit: Vernal means relating to spring, the season that opens the year's cycle.

clue.text: Church dignitary that's opposed to 15

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a senior Roman Catholic prelate
second meaning: a counting number such as one, two, three, contrasted with the answer to 15, which gives position

explanation.walkthrough: 15 across is ORDINAL; cardinal and ordinal numbers are the paired categories.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a prince of the Catholic Church and a counting number as against a positional one.

clue.text: A selfish desire to get something done!

parts.note: taken as written
greed is a selfish desire for more

explanation.surface: A grasping person's urge to get a deal settled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Done!' is said when striking a bargain, meaning it is settled.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying 'Done!' to close a deal is the same as saying 'Agreed!'

clue.text: Be inclined to write things in order

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to lean over to one side, as a ship does
second meaning: to set items down one after another

explanation.definitionFit: The verb covers a ship leaning to one side and setting items down as an itemised sequence.

clue.text: Name a small number after one in ultrashort time

parts.note: taken as written
No. is the shortened form of number, so a small version of the word
the one coming after the first is the second

explanation.surface: Naming a tiny figure in the briefest possible moment.
explanation.definitionFit: A billionth of a second, the standard example of a vanishingly brief interval.

clue.text: Take wicket, then settle down in ground in final season

parts.note: W is the scorecard abbreviation for a wicket taken
to inter is to bury, laying a body in the earth

explanation.surface: A bowler takes a wicket and then the match settles on its ground late in the year.
explanation.definitionFit: The cold months are the last of the four seasons in the calendar year.

clue.text: Two days before Ides of March, say, unluckily positioned?

definitions.text: Two days before Ides of March, say
definitions.meaning: first meaning: the Ides of March is the 15th, so two days earlier is this date
second meaning: in place number thirteen, a number thought unlucky

explanation.definitionFit: The ordinal for thirteen names a date in a month and a place in a sequence superstitiously considered ill-omened.

clue.text: Kind of yarn in the reply after exchange of a couple of letters

indicators.text: after exchange of a couple of letters
indicators.note: two adjacent letters in the phrase swap places, a minimal rearrangement

explanation.surface: A tall story told in the reply once two letters have been swapped.
explanation.walkthrough: Swap the E and R in THEREPLY to get the answer. Yarn looks like a story but is knitting wool.
explanation.definitionFit: Wool spun from three strands twisted together is a common grade of knitting wool.

clue.text: Service guide available from Ford in album

indicators.note: the answer can be got straight out of the run of letters that follows

parts.note: the answer runs across these words, from the second letter of Ford to the start of album

explanation.surface: A car service manual that comes with a Ford, found in an album.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Service guide' suggests a car manual alongside Ford, but it is a church book.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordinal is a book setting out the order of church services or ordination rites.

clue.text: Dine out after start of play -— one of fifteen occupying a certain table

definitions.text: one of fifteen occupying a certain table

indicators.note: the first part named follows the second in the answer

parts.note: Act I is the opening of a play

indicators.note: out signals the letters of the word are scrambled

explanation.surface: Going out to dinner after the curtain rises.
explanation.walkthrough: The actinides are the fifteen elements from actinium to lawrencium in the periodic table.
explanation.definitionFit: Each actinide is a member of a fifteen-element series in the periodic table of chemistry.

clue.text: Fourth book nurse composed about doctor

indicators.note: going round, so the scrambled letters wrap around the doctor
made up into a new arrangement of letters

parts.note: MB is a Bachelor of Medicine degree

explanation.surface: A nurse, calm around the doctor, reading the fourth volume.
explanation.walkthrough: Composed looks like calm here but signals rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Numbers is the fourth book of the Old Testament, after Genesis, Exodus and Leviticus.

clue.text: Mistreated those trapped by informer — that keeps resistance under control

indicators.note: caught within, so the scrambled letters sit inside the informer

parts.note: a rat is slang for one who informs on others

indicators.note: badly handled, so the letters are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: Abused people caught by a grass, who keeps the opposition in check.
explanation.walkthrough: Resistance is the electrical kind, not political opposition.
explanation.definitionFit: A rheostat is a variable resistor used to regulate electrical current.

clue.text: Leave game after three, we hear

parts.note: Go is a board game from East Asia

indicators.note: as spoken, signalling a word of the same sound but different spelling

parts.note: the position after third is fourth

explanation.surface: Leaving a match after three games, so we're told.
explanation.definitionFit: To go forth is an old-fashioned way to say depart or set out.

clue.text: Number that's loud also heard

indicators.note: spoken aloud, so the pieces give the answer's sound, not its spelling

parts.note: forte is the musical term for loud and too means also; said together they give the sound of the number

explanation.surface: A figure shouted out and heard as well.
explanation.walkthrough: Forte, said with the stress at the front, sounds like the first part of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a whole number, famous as the answer to everything in The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy.

clue.text: Not acting, arrange an evening out

definitions.meaning: first meaning: ..., away from the film set and so not performing
second meaning: to counterbalance, arranging things so they even out

explanation.walkthrough: 'An evening out' looks like a night on the town but means making things even.
explanation.definitionFit: To offset is to compensate or balance one thing against another so they cancel.

clue.text: Second coffee and third piece of tart

parts.note: a latte is a milky coffee

indicators.note: asks for only the letter in third position of the following word

parts.note: its letters run T, A, R, T, so the third one is R

explanation.surface: Ordering another coffee and a slice of tart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Second' looks like a second cup, but it means the latter of two.
explanation.definitionFit: The latter is the second of two things just mentioned.

clue.text: Young woman having cool drink on 4th of June

parts.note: lassi is a chilled Indian yoghurt drink
the fourth letter of the word June

explanation.surface: A girl having a chilled drink on a summer date.
explanation.walkthrough: '4th of June' looks like a date, but it is the fourth letter of June.
explanation.definitionFit: Lassie is a Scottish and northern English word for a girl.

clue.text: As for No 10 being reformed, PM starts with these

indicators.note: reshaped into a new form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
the number written out as a word

explanation.surface: Plans to reform Number 10, Downing Street, with a new Prime Minister starting.
explanation.walkthrough: PM looks like the Prime Minister beside No 10, but it means post meridiem: every afternoon begins at noon.
explanation.definitionFit: The abbreviation p.m. marks hours after midday, the period these times of day occupy.

clue.text: Continue as ultimate model for Oxford, say

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to go on, endure
third meaning: a cobbler's foot-shaped form, on which a shoe such as an Oxford is made

explanation.walkthrough: An Oxford is a lace-up shoe, not the university city.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means to endure, means final, and names the shoemaker's wooden foot form.

clue.text: What, historically, Martha became, following double first

definitions.text: What, historically, Martha became, following double first

parts.words: What, historically, Martha became, following double first
parts.note: Martha Washington, wife of the first US president, became the first to hold a title that itself begins with first, so first is doubled

explanation.walkthrough: Martha Washington became the first First Lady; put FIRST before the answer to get her title.
explanation.definitionFit: First Lady is the title for a US president's wife, and Martha Washington was the original.

clue.text: Shut up and take notice — this group's bigger than ABBA

parts.note: pent means confined, as in pent up
an ad is a notice in a newspaper

explanation.surface: Be quiet and pay attention: this band outnumbers the Swedish pop group.
explanation.walkthrough: ABBA had four members, so a group bigger by one has five.
explanation.definitionFit: A pentad is a set of five, one more than the four-strong Swedish band.

clue.text: Guy taking bronze from place to field

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the man who finishes in third place and wins the bronze medal
second meaning: a fielding position in cricket, behind the wicket on the off side

explanation.walkthrough: Third man is a cricket fielding position, deep behind the batsman on the off side.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names a third-placed male finisher and a deep fielding post near the boundary in cricket.
